documents.title: macOS Agent Host epoch recovery
documents.body: Use this experience when a macOS Apple Silicon Electron Agent Host restarts and stale Extension UI projections remain visible. Increment the Host epoch, cancel projections from the old epoch, restore the Pi JSONL Session, and verify one new Turn completes. Do not use this procedure for Windows service recovery.
queries: macOS 重启 Agent Host 后旧 Extension UI 还显示怎么办
How should stale projections be cancelled after an Electron host epoch changes on Apple Silicon?
恢复 macOS packaged app 的 Pi JSONL 会话并清掉旧 host projection
Agent Host epoch 切换后继续显示上一次工具 UI
Apple Silicon desktop host restart session recovery procedure

documents.title: Windows process tree cleanup
documents.body: Use this experience for Windows x64 packaged process cleanup. Terminate the exact owned child process tree through the Windows Job Object, wait for bounded shutdown, and verify no owned worker remains. Do not apply this macOS process logic or run broad process-name deletion.
queries: Windows x64 打包应用如何清理自己启动的子进程树
Job Object bounded shutdown for an owned package worker
不要按进程名批量杀进程，应该怎样回收 Windows worker
Windows installer leaves an owned Agent Host child running
exact process tree cleanup after Windows packaged app exits

documents.title: Extension UI cancellation at Host epoch boundary
documents.body: When any desktop Host epoch changes, reject events from the prior epoch and settle pending Extension UI operations as cancelled. Renderer projections must never survive their owning Host. This is a cross-platform UI lifecycle rule and does not replace Session resume.
queries: Host epoch 变化时 Extension UI 应该如何处理
Reject stale extension events after utility process recovery
Renderer 上遗留了前一个 Host 拥有的审批 Projection
cross-platform extension UI lifecycle during host replacement
pending Extension operation needs cancellation when host owner disappears

documents.title: Single OpenViking memory owner
documents.body: Pi-67 Desktop permits one OpenViking Context and Memory owner. If two OpenViking owners are detected, disable the conflicting Memory runtime, keep Pi chat and ordinary tools available, and fall back to Pi native compaction. Retired observational-memory and Hy-Memory names are migration identifiers, not active owners.
queries: 检测到两个 OpenViking Owner 时应该禁用什么
Why should Pi chat continue when memory-owner preflight fails?
OM 和 Hy-Memory 已退役后还算 active context owner 吗
duplicate OpenViking extensions and native Pi compaction fallback
Memory fail-closed but Agent fail-open ownership rule

documents.title: Enterprise shared Experience revoke-first lifecycle
documents.body: For an enterprise shared Experience, revoke DataHub retrieval eligibility before attempting external OpenViking deletion. The active Account and Project allowlist must stop recall immediately even if the vector or resource still exists. Preserve audit records and do not delete the private source Memory.
queries: 企业共享经验撤回时为什么要先阻断检索再删除 OpenViking
revoked Experience vector still exists but must not be recalled
撤回团队经验不能顺便删除私人 Memory
DataHub active allowlist revoke-first workflow
how to audit external resource deletion after shared asset revoke

documents.title: Windows Chinese username effective-config doctor
documents.body: On Windows with a Chinese username or spaces in the user path, the Doctor must compare disk configuration, the configuration actually loaded by the Pi Extension, and the OpenViking server capability. Showing only config.json is insufficient. Keep the Agent usable when Memory configuration fails.
queries: Windows 中文用户名导致 OpenViking 插件配置不生效怎么诊断
Doctor should show effective loaded values instead of only config.json
带空格用户路径下 Pi Extension 实际配置检查
disk config differs from loaded OpenViking plugin settings
Memory 配置失败时仍然允许 Agent 正常聊天

documents.title: OpenViking Context Takeover fail-open fallback
documents.body: When OpenViking Context Takeover cannot flush pending writes, commit the Session, or obtain an archive overview, it must not replace local history. Pi keeps the full local context or performs native compaction, then continues the Turn and supports restart Resume from the same JSONL Session.
queries: OpenViking 断线时 Context Takeover 应该如何回退
archive overview unavailable during Pi compaction
pending writes cannot flush but the conversation must continue
native compaction and restart resume after memory server failure
Takeover 失败后不能丢掉本地完整历史

documents.title: Stable Workspace identity fingerprint
documents.body: Identify a Workspace with the Account, user, repository remote hash, repository root identity hash, and optional relative Workspace id. Do not use only the folder name. Stable fingerprints avoid collisions between projects both named frontend and survive folder moves or different local paths.
queries: 两个都叫 frontend 的项目如何避免记忆串线
workspace identity should survive moving the folder
repository remote hash and root identity for project memory scope
不同用户本地路径不同但需要同一个项目身份
why a directory basename is not a safe Workspace fingerprint

documents.title: Paid livestream traffic without conversion
documents.body: Use this commerce experience when paid livestream traffic rises but orders do not. Check audience intent, product-card click-through, landing price consistency, anchor explanation, inventory availability, and checkout errors before increasing spend. Do not conclude that more traffic alone will repair conversion.

投流后商品卡点击率和结算错误怎么排查
为什么不能继续加预算解决直播转化低
livestream audience intent and product price consistency diagnosis

documents.title: Product card low conversion workflow
documents.body: Use this workflow when a product card receives clicks but conversion remains low. Verify offer clarity, price ladder, reviews, stock, delivery promise, variant defaults, and mobile checkout friction. Separate click-through problems from post-click conversion problems before changing creative.

documents.title: Product-preserving image generation
documents.body: For commerce image generation, preserve the exact product silhouette, logo placement, packaging structure, color, and distinguishing details. Change only the approved background, lighting, layout, or supporting props. Reject outputs that beautify by inventing a different product.

product identity preservation checklist for ecommerce creative

documents.title: Short-video opening hook design
documents.body: Design a short-video opening hook by making the audience, tension, promised payoff, and first visual action clear within the opening seconds. The hook must match the actual product proof that follows. Avoid unsupported absolute claims and do not optimize watch time with a misleading promise.
queries: 短视频开头三秒的 hook 应该包含什么
make audience tension and promised payoff clear in the opening visual
不能用后续产品证据无法支撑的绝对化开场
